digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend and reconciler contract
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend is missing query_project and assert_env_ready members required by the Backend protocol, making isinstance(backend, Backend) return False on merged main
reconciler.backend config validator rejects 'jira-datacenter' despite the backend being registered and importable, making DC deployments unreachable through configuration

DC inbound identity minting fails silently because accountId guard returns early for DC users who carry name/key instead, combined with channel-validation rejection of 'jira-datacenter' creation_channel
the two identity-minting defects compound: fixing only the accountId guard surfaces a latent ValueError that remains swallowed at DEBUG, making incremental fixes worse not better
a writing reconcile pass against real Jira DC crashes due to set_entity_property not being declared in TicketTransport protocol despite the core calling it from three sites
